_visibility_comment: Stated OUTRIGHT rather than omitted, and this is load-bearing.
build_views.repo_is_public() reads an ABSENT precedent.json as private
(no config at all -- not a Precedent repo) but a PRESENT one with no
`visibility` key as PUBLIC, on the reasoning that omitting the field is
how a public repo publishes private practice text by accident. This repo
is private and was relying on the absent-file path. Introducing this file
without declaring the field would therefore have flipped it to public and
silently dropped team- and individual-level practices from the tracked
loader block and the materialized tree -- the exact 'declared public,
actually private' failure that function's own docstring names.
Verified before and after this file was added: repo_is_public() stays
_fallback_timezone_comment: The zone used to stamp commits and generated dates in THIS repo when
nobody's own zone could be resolved -- no PRECEDENT_COMMIT_TZ, no
identity.json reachable, no TZ in the environment.
Set here because this is the one practice set with more than one
approver. The engine's built-in last resort is
America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires, which is Morgan's own zone and the right
answer in his individual source -- but wrong as the default for a shared
set, where an unidentified person is as likely to be anyone else.
New York is this team's declared answer instead. Morgan, 2026-09-10.
It is APPLIED and never ENFORCED, exactly as the engine-level fallback
is. Applied, because the alternative is not 'no zone' -- it is the
container's UTC, silently, and a record stamped +0000 by somebody who is
not in UTC cannot be ordered against anyone else's. Never enforced,
because refusing a person's commit over a zone THEY never declared would
block real work on a value they never saw; declaring a timezone in your
own identity.json is what makes it yours and checked.
This is the REPO-level rung of the ladder in tools/precedent_time.py: a
person's zone is person-level and belongs in their identity.json, while
the answer for a person this project could not identify is the
repository's to choose. Set here rather than by editing the vendored
hook (practice: layered-practice-packs, registry-source-of-truth).
Read by .claude/hooks/commit-identity.sh's _repo_fallback_tz() and by
tools/precedent_time.py's _repo_fallback_zone(), which take it ahead of
their own built-in default. practice: timestamps-carry-offset.
